scope: New O07/F07 native local release acceptance. Synthetic events traversed A4090, the existing VPN receiver, B3080 official Livehime browser material and DSH playback receipts. No public broadcast or recording was started. Historical benchmark records were not edited.

audition_browser_decode.note: AudioContext resamples to its native playback rate; this is not the WAV source rate

first_attempt.remediation: Reloaded the official native browser material with explicit buffer_ms=4000 and release query. Retained original FP16/batch8 and model steps. The fresh-material retest follows; this does not prove the cause of all earlier stalls.

steps.text: 大家好，我是林知夏。画面和声音在四零九零生成，通过虚拟网络传给三零八零设备上的直播姬。

events.text: 大家好，我是林知夏。画面和声音在四零九零生成，通过虚拟网络传给三零八零设备上的直播姬。

steps.text: 现在听到的是欧零七主用音色。声音从浏览器素材内部送出，人物保持日光宿舍场景。

events.text: 现在听到的是欧零七主用音色。声音从浏览器素材内部送出，人物保持日光宿舍场景。

steps.text: 刚才暂停了一下，现在继续。人物、动作和声音应该自然连贯。

events.text: 刚才暂停了一下，现在继续。人物、动作和声音应该自然连贯。

steps.text: 现在切换到备用音色，收到你的留言啦。人物、动作和当前会话仍然保留。

events.text: 现在切换到备用音色，收到你的留言啦。人物、动作和当前会话仍然保留。

steps.text: 请用一句简短的话说出你的名字，并说说刚才画面是由哪台设备生成、由什么客户端接收的。

events.text: 我是林知夏；刚才画面由四零九零生成，经虚拟网络传给三零八零设备上的直播姬接收。

local_acceptance.receipt_clock: All phase deltas use A server timestamps. First positive receipt is a proxy for playback, not an acoustic or audience-CDN measurement. B elapsed_ms is its separate whole-case clock.

final_runtime.health_source: read-only live status after all tests

resource_observation.scope: Whole A-device point observation after tests; not a sampled peak or per-process allocation

limitations: Public real-comment, gift and audience-CDN acceptance was not repeated with these voices.
Official source canvas/Web Audio receipts do not prove an audience heard the broadcast or that the official encoder captured every frame.
Five cases and point resource samples are not a long-duration soak test.
Prior memory-maintenance budget deferral and public/official room-state reconciliation remain separate unresolved gates.
Models use complete-waveform generation; no claim of token-level streaming TTS.
